headline: Japan's MEXT: Chinese companies and universities surpass US in 2024 R&D spending, ranking first globally
summary: Japan's education ministry's Science and Technology Indicators 2026, released on 7 August, show China's 2024 R&D spending at 97.1 trillion yen, up 13.1%, above the United States' 95.3 trillion yen.
why: R&D spending indicates the pace of technological investment, which shapes long-term competitiveness in sectors such as semiconductors, AI and advanced manufacturing.
